import sys, os, subprocess, tempfile, pathlib, json, ctypes
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
# emulate the public child: seccomp filter + rlimits + exec of the frozen run.py
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('public_child', '/workspace/public_child.py')
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
source = pathlib.Path('/workspace/public_child.py').read_text()
tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
proj = pathlib.Path(tmp)/'project'
proj.mkdir()
for f in pathlib.Path('/workspace/submission').rglob('*'):
    if f.is_file():
        dest = proj/f.relative_to('/workspace/submission')
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil = __import__('shutil'); shutil.copy(f, dest)
script = source.replace('if __name__ == \'__main__\':\n    main()', 'main()')
env = dict(os.environ, SYNECDOCHE_SITE='/workspace/site', LD_LIBRARY_PATH='/workspace/native',
           PYTHONPATH='/workspace/site', HOME=tmp, TMPDIR=tmp,
           PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', PYTHONUNBUFFERED='1', PYTHONHASHSEED='0',
           OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1', OMP_NUM_THREADS='1', MKL_NUM_THREADS='1')
payload = json.dumps(json.load(open('/tmp/req.json')), separators=(',',':')).encode()
code = ("import sys, os\n"
        "sys.argv = ['run.py']\n"
        "data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()\n"
        "import io\n"
        "sys.stdin = io.TextIOWrapper(io.BytesIO(data))\n"
        + script.replace("source_fd, filename, scratch = int(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]",
                         "source_fd, filename, scratch = -1, %r, %r" % (str(proj/'run.py'), tmp))
          .replace("    source = bytearray()\n    while True:\n        block = os.read(source_fd, 65536)\n        if not block:\n            break\n        source.extend(block)\n        if len(source) > 64*1024**2:\n            raise OSError('submission byte budget exceeded')\n    os.close(source_fd)\n", ""))
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '-c', code], input=payload, capture_output=True, env=env, cwd=tmp)
print('rc', p.returncode)
print('stderr:', p.stderr.decode()[:800])
print('stdout head:', p.stdout[:100])
got = json.loads(p.stdout)
exp = json.load(open('/workspace/examples.json'))[0]['response']
print('MATCH' if got == exp else 'MISMATCH')
PYEOF
